long_biography.plain_text:
Integrated flat-steel production marked the point at which Fuat Tosyalı's family trade became a large industrial system. After learning metalwork in the nine-square-metre workshop established by his father, he and his brothers took over the workshop and created Tosyalı Metal Trade in 1988. Fuat then led the creation of steelmaking and export companies, consolidating them under Tosyalı Holding.

As chairman, Tosyalı directed the move beyond pipes and construction steel into flat steel, direct-reduced iron, joint ventures and overseas production. Algeria became the group's principal international platform, followed by manufacturing and port investments in other markets. Fuat is a family shareholder and operating founder; the facilities, production capacity and workforce are corporate assets.
